results.summary: Stage 0 Read for Contagion. record.json carries 83 inventory capabilities (79 built, 4 absent: pre-Burn Dive, Bodyprints, Rawshade, Zhool'Iza), taken over from the Codex dry pass of 2026-11-09 and re-checked against src (one Contagion commit since, 9fe1f933f0); all 29 built-evidence lines are accounted for in built_reviewed. Scope and decisions hold his words with sources: admission 2026-11-15, the 2026-11-10 card (weather and body lead; one dash at a cost; other useful tissue), mulch plain fertilizer, Dive and Bodyprints kept in, geometry-only sun, peaks look-only. Ten contradictions are open, three of them new: Bloom-time sun escape against his geometry ruling, the Coalescence stuck at Stage 1, and seven fix items still open that the source read describes as built. Three failure modes: the sky clock is not a decision, the body bargain collapses, green by counters but empty in play. Stage 1 opens with a draft live-walk proposal on the saved Contagion site (a_live_walk) before any design question; the Codex questions q01, q03 and q06 are answered and q02, q04, q05, q07 and q08 stay draft.

quick_look.scene: QUICK LOOK OFFERED: the saved Contagion site v3 (src/RimMandrake/Contagion/prep_site.py), paused for him: the standing Bloom; the tells (gawpsacks sink, rattlegropes shake) then a Repulsor-forced Burn with a UV-shy native and a Scaldhide in the open; one colonist making a single crossing between two roofed refuges under the Burn; a placed Coalescence attempting to absorb Unfinished (absorption has an open reach failure) and collapsing under the Burn; a colonist with a Monstrous grown limb in four facings; a touched colonist treated with the Sunbeam. It shows whether the tells and sky change read, whether natives take the Burn, and whether the whole-map Burn plays as one dash or a lockdown. It does not settle c_sundash (a Direct Sun ruling) or c_local (an agent's guess).

results.summary: Stage 1 turn: one ask sent (a_root, the proposed root text built from his 2026-10-20 experience line and his 2026-11-10 card), reviewed pass by a fresh Codex reviewer on round 2. Struck: a_live_walk (choosing who watches changes nothing built; the walk is offered as this turn's quick look instead) and round 1 of a_root (it reopened his weather-and-body ruling by asking whether the Coalescence should co-lead). q02, q04, q05, q07, q08 stay draft, unreviewed, held for stage 2 after the walk.
